title: Degree of numerical coefficients
statement: For a real coefficient family $c(S)$ indexed by subsets of $[n]$, define its numerical degree to be the largest cardinality of a subset $S$ with nonzero coefficient, taking the value $0$ when all coefficients vanish.
hypotheses_covered: A real coefficient for each subset of $[n]$
